IFN.text: a-b Quantification of IFN-γ intensity in CD3⁺ T cells and granzyme B intensity in CD8⁺ T cells after co-culture with patient-derived apCAFs (a) or mCAFs (b), relative to matched control conditions, n=3. c–d Proliferation analysis of T cells following co-culture with patient-derived apCAFs (c) or mCAFs (d), as assessed by CFSE dilution, compared with corresponding controls, n=3. Supplementary Fig. 11. IFN-γ– and TGF-β–associated apCAF and mCAF states

a-b Gene set scoring of IFN-γ (a) and TGF-β (b) signaling across NF, apCAF, and mCAF subtypes. c Quantification of MHC II on membrane of mouse-derived fibroblasts that received the indicated treatments by flow cytometry in triplicate. d Expression levels of mCAF-associated markers assessed by immunoblot in patient-derived mCAF under the indicated treatments. e-f Heatmaps depicting the expression profiles of apCAF (e) and mCAF (f) marker genes in patient-derived CAFs following the indicated treatments. g–h KEGG pathways upregulated in patient-derived CAFs following IFN-γ (g) or TGF-β (h) treatment. Data in the bar plots are presented as mean ± SD, n=3. One-way ANOVA. **p<0.01, ***p<0.001.
